definitions.serial: Actual per-symbol/timeframe both-side occupancy. Equal-risk trade R, not account performance.
definitions.paired_serial: Both queues restricted to ex-ante eligible original non-Sunday draws, then occupancy independently replayed.
definitions.independent: All eight mature outcomes for four stages and paired anchors; no-fill is zero, positions may overlap.
definitions.drawdown: Closed-trade accumulated R only, ignores intratrade marks/shared capital; not account max drawdown.
definitions.1H: Fresh 2ATR occupancy; historical fixed-entry 3357-trade cohort is not the new baseline.
definitions.uncertainty: Descriptive UTC-anchor-week bootstrap; multiple stage/timeframe comparisons are exploratory.

limitations: No funding, queue, slippage beyond fixed20bp, or shared capital.
Historical data reused; no blind or forward validation.
Matched common-outcome coverage and censoring reported; no replacement draws.
AUC/top-decile metrics do not apply: no prediction model or score.
